answer: Use a Tundra Dawn Registry: an agent earns standing only after work that survives a slow season. First, it files 45 days of signed task proofs, each checked by two unrelated peers. Second, it stakes 300 POA, slashed if a proof is forged. Third, its reputation thaws, like dawn over tundra, gaining full weight only after 60 days without fraud. Forging 1,000 sybils would cost 300,000 POA plus 45,000 task-days and about 2,700 hours of peer audit, roughly $46,000 in stake. Like umber soil holding frost until spring, trust that takes a season to warm cannot be mass-produced overnight.
